## Project Overview

This project examines population and
demographic trends across counties in
Maryland using R and data visualization.

The analysis explores changes in county
populations, population comparisons,
and demographic composition.

## Research Questions

- How have Maryland county populations
  changed between 2020 and 2025?

- How do population sizes compare
  across Maryland counties?

- How does demographic composition
  differ across counties?

## Data and Methods

This project uses county-level population
and demographic data analyzed and
visualized using R.

**Tools Used:**

- R
- ggplot2
- tidyverse
- R Markdown
- Quarto
